item.description:
Formula 0.1.49

  • Releases: after x.y.99 the next version is x.(y+1).0, so updates keep arriving (#75)
  • Windows: the test suite passes on Windows, and CI runs on main are left to finish [skip release] (#73)
  • New screens (preview): edit the brief by hand, add a pull request, and see what Formula has done (#68)
  • Relay security: source files are no longer downloadable, Slack posts cannot page or message people, and lookups are rationed (#72)
  • Support opens without an Intercom sign-in, and the app can read feature flags and production logs through Formula's relay (#62)
